title: 2017 1st Bowman Draft Chrome Refractor #BDC-104 Will Gaddis (RC) Rookie Rockies
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2017 Bowman Draft sports trading card features Will Gaddis, a rookie player for the Colorado Rockies in Major League Baseball (MLB). The card is part of the Chrome insert set and has a Refractor parallel/variety, making it a unique addition to any collection.

The card is numbered BDC-104 and manufactured by Topps. It does not include an autograph and is a single card from the 2017 season. This card is perfect for any baseball fan or collector looking to add a rare and valuable piece to their collection.
